_about: Declarative install contract for the ~/.claude workbench, read by installer/{deps,verify,doctor,selfheal}.py. Idempotent + fail-visible. Tokens: {PYTHON} {NODE} {CLAUDE_DIR} (from detect.py). `network:true` / `ci_stub:true` steps only PLAN (WOULD-*) under `install.py --ci` / `--dry-run`. `env_from` adds `-e NAME=$NAME` to an MCP registration only when NAME is set in the installer's environment (secrets never live in this file). MCP servers are registered user-scope into ~/.claude.json (the single live MCP store; settings.template.json has no mcpServers). Counts (skills, agents) are always computed from disk, never pinned here.

links._about: Skill trees that must be MATERIALIZED as real files (never symlinks) so Windows works. links.materialize() is idempotent verify-or-create.

leanctx_config._about: Merged (never clobbered) into ~/.config/lean-ctx/config.toml by the installer; doctor row lean-ctx-config verifies it + lean-ctx >= min_version. Key 'top' = the root table; every other key is a [table].

jcodemunch_config._about: Global jcodemunch-mcp keys in ~/.code-index/config.jsonc (outside ~/.claude, so a copied or fresh install keeps jcodemunch's stock tool_surface 'counter' = 6 menu tools and every get_context_bundle/plan_turn directive resolves to nothing). installer/jcodemunch_config.py writes them via `jcodemunch-mcp config set`; doctor row jcodemunch-config verifies. Scalars must match; lists are minimum members (extras such as D:\Projects are kept); {HOME} = this user's home.

mods._about: Claude Code mods (in-process TypeScript function-hook plugins) kept in this repo under mods/<id>/. render.py turns `enabled` into env.CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS (absolute paths, os.pathsep-joined) so every session on every machine loads them. The mods API is early access: `claude_version` is the minimum verified release; the doctor passes any later patch of the same minor and warns below it or on a newer minor (bump it after `scripts/validate_mods.py` passes there). Disable a mod by removing it here and re-rendering.

user_space._about: Base tools a brand-new Linux/macOS user lacks, installed WITHOUT sudo into ~/.local by installer/userspace.py (node/claude/uv/gh), installer/ollama_setup.py (ollama + models) and installer/ostools.py (apt-only OS tools: tried with root or `sudo -n`, otherwise ONE batched command printed at the end; never a failure). Claude Code is pinned to mods.claude_version so the mods row passes on a fresh machine.

gh.note: pinned release + SHA-256 (the release's checksums.txt); bump both together.

ollama.note: pinned release + SHA-256 (the release's sha256sum.txt) into ~/.local (no sudo); a `systemctl --user` unit ONLY when none exists and this is the binary the installer put in ~/.local/bin, else a detached `ollama serve` while the models are pulled.

human_only: Run `claude` once and sign in (account login).
Inside Claude Code run /mcp and authorize higgsfield and openart (OAuth).
Run `gh auth login` (the github MCP reads its token from it).
